verdict.rationale: Shopify's own B2B page says merchants can sell to businesses and consumers from one platform, with self-serve for business buyers and "all the B2B features you need." That covers the B2B-alongside-DTC core, but none of the specific wholesale mechanics are documented in the pack. Markets pricing evidence concerns regional pricing, not customer-specific price lists, so it is not credited. missing for 10: documented customer-specific price lists, volume/quantity pricing, quotes or draft orders, net-terms invoicing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can sell B2B and wholesale — customer-specific price lists, volume pricing, quotes or net-terms invoicing — alongside DTC

citations.quote: Sell to businesses and consumers from one platform. Your business buyers get modern self-serve, and you get all the B2B features you need.
